name: deck-reader
description: Reads a pitch deck (PDF) and writes a deck-completeness report next to it, with the grid of the stage the deck announces and the block of its business model. Pre-seed: completeness of the deck. Seed: completeness, plus every figure the deck states checked against the annexes provided and public sources, and a draft email to the founder for what is missing. Series A: the same with a fixed list of six required documents, net retention and unit economics as the heaviest blocks, and benchmarks shown next to every figure, never scored. No verdict, no investment recommendation.
